title: Puzzle 2d Canvas Text Labels Wrong
summary: Fixed puzzle 2d text labels not following nodes during drag: WASM/GPU updated geometry each frame but textOverlayDirty ignored node position changes, so paintTextOverlays skipped while the overlay canvas kept pre-drag pixels. Added bumpTextOverlayGeometryEpoch on nodeMove drain and peer applyNodePositionSilent. Regression test textOverlayDirty after live node drag geometry. @puzzle/2d/react vitest 107/107 pass.
